recipes.title: David's Roku + Denon + LG Setup
recipes.summary: David's everyday Clonker configuration, combining Roku ECP, Denon AVR control, and native LG webOS commands.
description: This complete Config v5 recipe is based on the active configuration exported from the physical Clonker using its configuration API.
Room 1, Den, uses Roku for navigation and playback, with a Denon receiver handling volume and mute. Movie, Music, and Vinyl Custom Actions invoke Denon Quick Select presets.
Room 2, Sunroom, uses Roku for navigation, playback, volume, and mute, controlling the Denon AVR volume through HDMI CEC.
The Sunroom also uses native LG webOS pointer commands for its Picture Cycle Custom Action, demonstrating three device types working together in one room.
The Den LG television is defined but has no assigned commands. Native control of this newer LG model remains under investigation.
The recipe includes stable Custom Action identifiers, placeholder LG client keys, and an unconfigured third room.
Download and import the JSON file through the Clonker configuration editor. Review device endpoints, commands, and authentication credentials before explicitly saving.
rooms: Room 1 -- Den: Roku navigation, Denon volume/mute, four Custom Actions
Room 2 -- Sunroom: Roku navigation, Roku volume/mute, native LG Picture Cycle, four Custom Actions
Room 3 -- Present but unconfigured; available for future expansion
custom_actions: Den: Movie → Roku Home, wait 3 seconds, Denon Quick Select 1
Den: Music → Roku Home, wait 3 seconds, Denon Quick Select 2
Den: Vinyl → Roku Home, wait 3 seconds, Denon Quick Select 3
Den: Audio Cycle → Cycle Denon Movie listening modes
Sunroom: Movie → Roku Home, wait 3 seconds, Denon Quick Select 1
Sunroom: Music → Roku Home, wait 3 seconds, Denon Quick Select 2
Sunroom: Audio Cycle → Cycle Denon Movie listening modes
Sunroom: Picture Cycle → Advance the LG picture mode using native pointer commands

recipes.title: David's LG webOS Starter
recipes.category: CONFIG V5 · ONE ROOM · HARDWARE TESTED
recipes.summary: David's working LG G1 OLED configuration, combining native webOS control with Wake-on-LAN power management.
description: This complete Config v5 recipe was developed and hardware tested during Chapter 13: The Monster Learns Another Language.
Room 1, Sunroom, contains a single configured LG webOS television. Volume and mute use SSAP commands, while navigation, Select, Back, and Home use pointer commands.
Power ON uses Wake-on-LAN, including recovery from extended standby. Power OFF uses LG SSAP.
Picture Cycle advances the television's picture mode using a timed sequence of pointer commands. TV Wake provides unconditional power-on independently of the remembered power-toggle direction.
Media transport controls are intentionally unassigned.
Replace the placeholder client key and both synthetic MAC addresses with your television's actual values. Review the device endpoint and broadcast address before explicitly saving.
rooms: Room 1 -- Sunroom: LG G1 OLED, native navigation, volume/mute, power control, two Custom Actions
custom_actions: Sunroom: Picture Cycle → Advance the LG picture mode using Quick Settings
Sunroom: TV Wake → Unconditional power-on using Wake-on-LAN
